page.overview:
Who is Curufin?

Curufin, also called Curufin the Crafty, was a Ñoldorin prince and the fifth of the seven Sons of Fëanor and Nerdanel. Curufin was the father of Celebrimbor, master Jewel-smith of Eregion who would later forge the three Elvish Rings of Power.

Among his seven brothers, Curufin was his father's favorite and was most like his father in skill of hand and in appearance.

Curufin was born in Valinor sometime during the Noontide of Valinor. There he married an unnamed Elf (most likely one of the Ñoldor) and had a son they named Celebrimbor, who would later follow Curufin to exile.

As with the other Sons of Fëanor, Curufin was bound by an oath to recover his father's Silmarils, which had been stolen by the Dark Lord Morgoth. His oath took him and his brothers to Middle-earth during the First Age.
